title: Change Order Administration Fee — Professional Services Projects
content:
For a restart change order on a Professional Services Projects engagement, and only for such a change order, the administration fee is the restart change order administration fee. Every other signed scope or schedule change carries the class change order administration fee, waived when the absolute value change is below the class waiver figure, and a pure schedule change with no value change is charged the fee.

| Signed change order | Administration fee |
|---|---|
| a restart change order | the restart change order administration fee |
| any other scope or schedule change whose absolute value change is above zero but below the class waiver figure | waived |
| any other scope or schedule change whose absolute value change is the class waiver figure or more | the class change order administration fee |
| a pure schedule change with no value change | the class change order administration fee |

## When the restart administration fee is fixed

The administration fee of a restart change order is fixed only after the engagement's change orders carry that change order signed by the client.

In the same terms: until the engagement's change orders show the restart change order in signed status, its administration fee is not yet fixed.

## Business effect

Posting the fee adds an administration fee charge naming the change order to the engagement's billing; the engagement's billing then carries the administration fee posted for that change order.

## Posting tool: `post_change_order_fee_93724a4c`

**Capability.** Posts the administration fee of a signed change order to the engagement's billing. A new change order fee charge naming the change order is added with a newly assigned invoice number, today's date as its posting date and the current month as its billing month; the client can then see the fee and the change order it relates to on the engagement's billing.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_change_order_fee_93724a4c` (through `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `project_engagement_id` | the reference number of the project engagement the change order belongs to, as returned by the project engagement lookup | identifier |
| `change_order_number` | the change order number as shown on the signed change order | CO- followed by the statement of work digits, a hyphen and 2 digits |
| `amount_usd` | the administration fee in US dollars | a positive decimal number with 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A confirmation string giving the new billing entry reference, the invoice number (INV- followed by 6 digits), the engagement reference number, the change order number, the fee in US dollars with two decimal places and the posting date in year-month-day form; that string indicates the fee was posted.
